items.headline: Heat Advisory issued June 1 at 6:32PM AKDT until June 2 at 8:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures 80 to 85 expected in areas away from the
inner channels and outer coast.

* WHERE...City of Hyder, Ketchikan Gateway Borough, and Prince
of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 8 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related
illnesses.
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough; City of Hyder
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Young children and pets should never be left unattended in
vehicles under any circumstances as vehicle interiors can reach
extreme temperatures in as little as 10 minutes

items.headline: Flood Watch issued June 1 at 3:39PM AKDT until June 3 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Kodiak Island, including the communities of Kodiak City,
Port Lions, Ouzinkie, Old Harbor.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff from heavy rain may result in flooding
of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone
locations, including Bells Flats. Heavy rain may saturate soils,
resulting in isolated landslides in areas of steep terrain. Strong
east to northeast winds
items.areas: Kodiak Island Northeast; Kodiak Island Southwest
items.instruction:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 1 at 3:34PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A front approaching the area will continue to bring gusty
northeast winds along the Northern Bristol Bay Coast through late
this evening. Gusts up to 45 mph, with isolated ones to 55 mph,
will persist through late this evening before slowly diminishing
through Tuesday morning.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued June 1 at 5:35AM AKDT until June 1 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Kodiak Island.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result. Downed trees are also possible due to
the combination of strong winds and saturated soils from expected
excessive rainfall.
